_comment: E1 semantic scenario manifest. Each scenario is identity + route + checkpoint + negative controls. Input grammar is drive.gd's; shots are milliseconds from the settle boundary. Every scenario names the deterministic channels its captures are compared under. owned_by: tools/checkpoint.gd (engine sidecar writer) and tools/verify_scenarios.py (comparison runner).

identity.install: user-supplied retail Sacred Gold install; its identity is recorded per run, never assumed

tolerated_channels.name: anim_clip_time
tolerated_channels.reason: a looping clip cannot be frozen at the same frame by two wall-clock runs; pose equality is what 0.05 s of a 1.38 s idle clip means

tolerated_channels.name: pixel_fx_tolerance
tolerated_channels.reason: retail miniature animations (lamp/torch flames) tick on shader wall-clock TIME, whose epoch the port already documents as unsynchronized; a scenario capture may differ by a handful of flame pixels. Every tolerated difference is counted and reported, never masked; poses, HUD and state remain exact.

scenarios.name: spawn-settled

expect._note: quest 74's OnEnter writes no state bit (audit row: OnExit writes 3); quest_states stays empty at spawn. expect blocks are asserted by future runner versions, not decorative.

controls.wrong_state_refuses: a reference whose cast_handles or quest_states differ must fail comparison, not pixel-compare

scenarios._note: freeze_anim parks every rig at this clip time before checkpoint+shots, making pixel repeats pose-aligned (E1 contract).

scenarios.name: click-walk-arrive

checkpoint.arrive: player cell within 0.6 of the clicked cell's centre and sim state quiescent (no pending goal)
checkpoint.expect_anim: WALK during travel frames; IDLE once arrived

controls.lost_input_refuses: if the click never produced a click_goal fact line, the run refuses rather than capturing a standstill and calling it the reference
controls.unfinished_load_refuses: capture waits for production readiness; a timeout is an error, never a partial-scene score

scenarios._note: freeze_anim parks every rig at this clip time before checkpoint+shots, making pixel repeats pose-aligned (E1 contract).
scenarios.pixel_gate_reason: sim advance is still wall-clock-coupled outside fixed-tick drives (W1 owns continuous-walk determinism); until then the drive segment's pixels are reported, not gating. State checkpoints remain gating.
